list.title: Downloads
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, URL, category or status
list.emptyBody: Paste a link, drop a .torrent file, or send links from your browser.
list.emptyFilteredBody: No downloads match the current filter.

add.title: Add Download
add.metadataPending: Torrent metadata is not available yet. It will be fetched when the download starts.
add.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg was not found, so only formats that already contain audio and video are offered.
add.invalidUrl: Enter a valid http(s) link or magnet link.
add.multiHint: Tip: paste several links at once (one per line) to add them together.
add.checksumPlaceholder: Paste the publisher's SHA-256 to verify the file
add.checksumInvalid: A SHA-256 checksum is 64 hexadecimal characters.

details.title: Download details
details.segmentMapLabel: Download progress by part: {{percent}}% of {{count}} parts

history.title: History
history.clearConfirmBody: Finished, failed and cancelled entries will be removed from the list. Downloaded files are not deleted.
history.name: Name

remove.title: Remove download?
remove.body: “{{name}}” will be removed from the list.
remove.deleteFile: Also delete the downloaded file from disk
remove.partialNote: Partially downloaded data will be deleted.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel download?
cancelConfirm.body: Downloaded data for “{{name}}” will be deleted. You can restart it later.

power.shutdown: The computer will shut down in {{seconds}} s because the download queue finished.
power.sleep: The computer will go to sleep in {{seconds}} s because the download queue finished.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clipboardHint: Clipboard text is checked locally and never stored or sent anywhere.
settings.connectionsPerDesc: 1–32. Large files are split into parts downloaded in parallel; if a server allows fewer connections, fewer are used.
settings.askDestination: Ask where to save each download
settings.limitNote: HTTP downloads share the limit exactly. Torrents apply it session-wide; video downloads apply it per download when they start.
settings.proxyHint: http://, https:// or socks5:// — authenticated proxies are not stored.
settings.scheduleEnabled: Only download during a time window
settings.afterHint: A 60-second countdown is shown first and can be cancelled.
settings.browserEnabled: Accept downloads from the browser extension
settings.hostMissing: Not found next to the application
settings.extraIdsHint: One 32-letter ID per line. Allows your own extension to use the protocol.
settings.installHint: Downloads the official release from github.com/yt-dlp and verifies its SHA-256 checksum.
settings.ffmpegHint: Install FFmpeg (for example: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg) or set its path.
settings.torrentNotStarted: Starts when the first torrent is added
settings.enableDht: Enable DHT (needed for most magnet links)
settings.categoriesHint: Downloads are categorised by file extension. You can always change a download's category.
settings.jsRuntimeOk: yt-dlp uses it to read YouTube's player; nothing else runs with it.
settings.jsRuntimeHint: YouTube needs a JavaScript runtime for yt-dlp. Install Deno (official release, SHA-256 verified) or point to Node.js / Bun.

about.title: About
about.updatesNote: Automatic updates are not enabled in this build. New versions are published as signed installers on the project's releases page.
about.privacy: pixidl does not collect analytics and never sends your data anywhere.

firstRun.intro: A few quick choices and you're ready. You can change everything later in Settings.
firstRun.startup: Launch pixidl when I sign in
firstRun.tray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed

extensions.title: Browser extension
extensions.subtitle: Send links from any website to pixidl with one click. Choose your browser to get the extension.
extensions.featSelectionBody: Select links on a page and a small download button appears beside them.
extensions.featDetectBody: The extension spots download links on every page and counts them on its icon.
extensions.featPickerBody: See file names and sizes, tick the ones you want, and send them together.
extensions.featYoutubeBody: A Download button on YouTube opens pixidl to pick the quality or audio only.
extensions.privacy: The extension only talks to pixidl on this computer. It collects nothing and sends nothing to the internet.
extensions.saved: The extension was saved to your downloads folder:
extensions.orType: or type in the address bar:
extensions.stepDevMode: Turn on “Developer mode” (switch at the top of the page).
extensions.stepLoadUnpacked: Click “Load unpacked” and choose this folder:
extensions.stepFirefoxLoad: Click “Load Temporary Add-on…” and choose manifest.json in this folder:
extensions.firefoxNote: Regular Firefox only keeps temporary add-ons until it restarts; a permanent install needs the add-on signed by Mozilla (addons.mozilla.org). Firefox Developer Edition and Nightly can install the .xpi file directly after setting xpinstall.signatures.required to false in about:config.
extensions.stepPin: Done! Pin the pixidl icon in the toolbar. The status here turns green as soon as the extension connects.
